crop.notes: Whole item 'Shot at the "Shades"'; the last piece also catches the next headline 'Hobbs' Horoscope'.

ocr.notes: Mostly right; scattered errors ('Durroi's' for Carroll's, 'Nat Y. Kelly').

title.suggested: Billy Carroll, Backer of Allen's Fights, Shoots Man in His Saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Billy Carroll, once the banker for prize fights in which Tom Allen appeared, shot clerk Nat F. Kelly in his Pine Street saloon, the 'Carroll Shades'; Kelly was not expected to live.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, February 13, 1882', page 4. The shooting was the previous afternoon, Feb. 12.

facts.fact: Billy Carroll, a St. Louis saloon and variety-theater manager, had been the banker in various sporting enterprises, notably the prize fights in which Allen appeared

notes: The article is about Carroll's shooting of Kelly; Allen is named only in Carroll's background. The current summary says Carroll managed fights 'with' Allen; the paper says he was the banker for fights in which Allen appeared.
